note: Four N-terminal/conformational anti-tau antibodies cut tau in FTD-mutant (P301L/P301S) mice and all failed in amyloid-positive early-to-moderate AD despite engaging N-terminal tau; a human AD-seed assay had called them weak in 2018.

engagement.model: P301L/P301S tau-transgenic mice (JNPL3, P301S, P301L, rTg4510)

engagement.model: AD-patient-derived cortical-neuron eTau in human neurons and two human-tau transgenic mouse lines

engagement.model: AD-patient-derived cortical-neuron eTau in human neurons and two human-tau transgenic mouse lines

The model side is read at abstract level.

In TANGO the antibody removed unbound N-terminal tau from CSF at all doses (P < 0.0001) but Abeta42 did not change against placebo (-8.99 pg/ml, -1.90%, high dose; -17.38 pg/ml, -3.81%, placebo), so the downstream readout the model used did not move: contra, readout downstream. product_in_model false: Bright used the IPN002 lineage, not the humanized product. engagement.judgement: Opens the sponsor's own ex-vivo track at first publication; the humanized product, not a murine parent, was used (product_in_model true).

Lauriet (Monteiro 2023, mild-to-moderate AD, same antibody) later met one co-primary (ADAS-Cog11, -42.2%) but not ADCS-ADL and 'this study was negative'; under the one-contra-beats-one-same rule, with no tier 1-4 evidence that the Tauriel signal attenuated, the track stays contra and Lauriet is logged in the 2023 entry's patient_trials.

Scored neg rather than same because the assay's own number for a member's V-region (antibody A, inactive) fell below the assay's selection bar and that member failed (decision 13). Florian 2023 (tilavonemab) draws the same lesson: 'anti-tau antibodies directed against the N-terminus may be less effective than those that target the mid-domain region.' product_in_model false: antibodies A and B carry the clinical V-regions in a mouse IgG1 backbone, not the products.
